title: Fake Security Badge Renewal
scenario: Facilities email asks for ID scans through a new badge-renewal site.

answers.A: Act immediately because the request sounds urgent and important.
answers.B: Use the approved company system or verified process.
answers.C: Reply to the sender asking them to confirm the request.
answers.D: Escalate to IT, finance, HR, legal, or your manager through official channels.

explanation: Fake Security Badge Renewal: the trap is to move you from a trusted channel to a fake page. The safer move is to verify through an official or approved channel, not to act before verifying.
proTip: Badge renewals should use official facility systems.
